# Adeeb Bashir (zentex)

> Founder and security researcher in Kashmir. Builds warm.run and routing.run, ships open source developer tools, and takes authorized security engagements only.

## Pages
- [Adeeb Bashir · zentex · founder and security researcher](https://zent7x.com/): Adeeb Bashir, also zentex. Founder of warm.run and routing.run. Authorized security research from Kashmir.
- [Writing · zentex](https://zent7x.com/blog): Short posts about LLM routing, agent loops, terminals, and security work by Adeeb Bashir (zentex).
- [Real Chromium pixels in your terminal · zentex](https://zent7x.com/blog/chromium-in-the-terminal): Why terminal-fenster paints actual browser frames into Ghostty instead of faking a text mode web.
- [Zero prompt logging is the product · zentex](https://zent7x.com/blog/zero-prompt-logging): The router in the middle sees everything. routing.run is built on the idea that it should remember nothing.
- [Authorized means written down · zentex](https://zent7x.com/blog/authorized-means-written): How I run security engagements, and why nothing happens before the scope exists on paper.
- [Pack the repo, not the prompt · zentex](https://zent7x.com/blog/pack-the-repo-not-the-prompt): grasp indexes a codebase too big for one window, then packs only the source that belongs in the prompt.

## Projects
- [terminal-fenster](https://zent7x.com/terminal-fenster/): Real Chromium pixels inside your terminal.
- [grasp](https://github.com/zent7x/grasp): Code context for agents on repos too big for one window.
- [codemap](https://github.com/zent7x/codemap): Any repository as a self contained explorable map.
- [cogrep](https://github.com/zent7x/cogrep): Local semantic code search and clone detection.
- [tally](https://github.com/zent7x/tally): Private finance planning in your browser. Import bank CSVs, manage budgets, and plan uneven income.
